name: Teal Rogers
biography: is a dedicated maker and software designer who has been advancing existing products through innovative new interfaces for years. Between being a brilliant imagineer, rogue inventor, warrior-poet, master of surprise, and student of the arcane he has managed to design and sell the highest quality laser gloves on the market. More recently, he has been inexorably drawn to the nascent power of the 3rd dimension.
